faqs.q: Sec. 98-108.1. - Kipling Ridge Cooperation Agreement Credit.
faqs.a:
Notwithstanding any other provisions of this chapter, there shall be granted to each
               person obligated to remit the sales tax on retail sales transactions occurring at
               retail sales outlets on the property, described in Exhibit A to the Cooperation Agreement
               dated December 13, 2004, by and among the city, Arvada Urban Renewal Authority, Ridge
               Venture, LLC and Kipling Ridge Metropolitan District (the "agreement") and incorporated
               herein by this reference. a tax credit against collection of the tax equal to the
               amount of the retail sales fee paid to the public improvement company as described
               in the agreement. The amount of the credit shall not exceed the amount of the sales
               tax. This credit shall terminate when the collection of the retail sales fee terminates.
               For purposes of this section, the term "retail sales fee" shall have the same meaning
               as the definition of "PIF" in the agreement, which fee is imposed on retail sales
               transactions occurring at retail sales outlets on the property.
(
Ord. No. 3935, § 2, 2-7-2005
)
